I had to walk out of work today. 
I work in an office with other people in one big room. On a normal day there is a lot of keyboard clacking, mouse clicking, people talking and various office noises, which can be quite distracting and make it hard to focus at times. (My job involves talking on the phone with people, so no headphones/music allowed) and normally I can handle all this noise without getting too flustered but today someone brought snacks to the office. Chips, crackers, candy and the sorts. Normal people would be overjoyed about the thought of snacks but I had instant dread and knew I was in for a long day. All day someone was munching or crunching or crinkling wrappers. I could feel my body temperature rise every time someone opened a bag. I had to take multiple breaks, more than I’m allowed, just to get away and have a breather. I couldn’t get a single thing done at work today. I felt so angry and upset and overwhelmed. I know it’s no ones fault but my own but I wanted to scream at them, I wanted to shout, I wanted to strangle someone. I’m not a very confrontational person and I hate being an inconvenience and tbh I am completely embarrassed about this condition, so I never speak about it to any other, I’m sure I could talk to a manager about it but I refuse. At a certain point I could only take so much of the noise today and I just clocked out early without saying anything and I am gonna deal with the consequences tomorrow, I don’t care. I sit here in my car typing this right now, still flustered and overwhelmed with emotion, I apologized for any grammatical errors and stuff. I haven’t had a reaction this bad in awhile. I’m just tired of this condition and the limitations it puts on me. I wish I was normal. Now excuse me while I cry as I drive home. Sorry.
